title: On a curve, the torsion-sheaf and the Z/n-module notions of constructibility agree
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field, $C$ a separated scheme of finite type over $k$ with $\dim C\le1$, $n\ge1$ an integer and $F$ an abelian sheaf on $C_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] with $nF=0$; then $F$ is torsion and $(C,F)$ is a curve coefficient pair [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting], and $F$ is a sheaf of $(\mathbf Z/n)_C$-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Then $F$ is constructible in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-constructible-torsion] (a finite partition of $C$ into locally closed constructible subschemes on each of which the restriction of $F$ is locally constant with finite stalks, as an abelian sheaf) if and only if $F$ is a constructible sheaf of $\mathbf Z/n$-modules in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] with $\Lambda=\mathbf Z/n$. (Ingredients: a constant abelian sheaf $\underline A$ on a nonempty $U$ with $n\underline A=0$ has $nA=0$, and $\underline A$ is then the constant sheaf of the $\mathbf Z/n$-module $A$; an abelian-sheaf isomorphism between $\mathbf Z/n$-module sheaves is $\mathbf Z/n$-linear; the geometric stalks of $\underline A|_{U}$ are $A$; both notions use finite partitions into constructible locally closed pieces, and $C$ is Noetherian.)

source.place: Definition 03RW (definition-constructible), parts (2) and (3), compared for Lambda = Z/n, with Lemma 095E (lemma-constructible-quasi-compact-quasi-separated); Definition 03RU (definition-finite-locally-constant). Not stated in Stacks, which passes between abelian sheaves killed by n and sheaves of Z/n-modules silently (proof of Theorem 03SC). Agent-formulated.
